postal_system.full_code_name: Dhekelia BFPO route and Cyprus postal assignments
postal_system.assignment_rule: Current GOV.UK evidence maps Dhekelia to BFPO 58 and shadow postcode BF1 2AU, while the current Cyprus Post workbook contains Dhekelia-related assignments 6370 and 7502. These are separate operator assertions and do not by themselves establish a postal Polygon/MultiPolygon.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Only a rights-cleared fixed geospatial postal resource may establish drawable membership. Dhekelia SBA territory, the combined Sovereign Base Areas, streets, communities, environmental maps, offices, addresses, points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never become postcode perimeters by implication.
postal_system.address_rule: BFPO routing, shadow-postcode equivalence, Cyprus Post assignment, postal-area membership, country identity, address and service state remain separate assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Building output requires a separately sourced explicit distributable address-building relationship or common authoritative identifier.
postal_system.administrative_rule: XD remains distinct from Cyprus, Akrotiri, Episkopi and Ayios Nikolaos. Administrative or sovereign-base descriptions are not merged or relabelled as postal areas.
postal_system.service_status_rule: BFPO eligibility, route/office state and delivery service are time-stamped assertions separate from area membership and deliverability.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> rights-cleared postal area or explicit non-area -> address graph -> explicit building relation -> AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: normalized BFPO 58, BF1 2AU, 6370 or 7502 -> operator assignment and exception evidence -> valid official/derived/virtual area or explicit non-area -> address context -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: explicit distributable relation, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: BFPO 58, BF1 2AU, 6370 and 7502 retain exact operator, normalization and equivalence semantics.
Current complete BFPO eligibility/routing and Cyprus Post assignment, exception and non-area denominators are fixed with dates, digests, correction policy and compatible rights.
XD, Cyprus, Akrotiri, Episkopi and Ayios Nikolaos identities remain distinct and are reconciled only by postal authority.
Every drawable code uses finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry in the declared CRS with lineage, class, date, confidence and exceptions.
Every assignment and geometry resource pins exact processing, storage, derivation, redistribution, public-serving and attribution permission.
Synthetic fixtures and shared code capability never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

The current complete Dhekelia BFPO 58 and BF1 2AU routing/eligibility denominator plus Cyprus Post 6370 and 7502 assignment, exception and explicit non-area denominator is pinned under reviewed rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Each normalized value reconciles to fixed finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry whose official/derived/virtual class, provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method, confidence and exceptions are recorded, or retains a source-grounded route, office, P.O.-box, organization, point or other non-area reason. Dhekelia SBA territory, combined Sovereign Base Areas, Cyprus territory, streets, communities, environmental maps, offices, addresses, buildings, parcels, points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never become postal perimeters by implication; XD, Cyprus, Akrotiri, Episkopi and Ayios Nikolaos identities are not changed or merged. The approved immutable artifact drives the real XD API/app, which normalizes all supported forms, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
Explicit address identifiers and points pass rights, schema, coverage, validity, privacy and correction gates.
Postal surfaces and building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, rights and quality gates.
